pages.text:
**Tin** is mined from the earth; **bronze** is alloyed from tin and copper. Both use the common c: tags, so other mods' tin and bronze work in Xincraft recipes and the other way round.

**Armor:** tin sits between copper and iron, bronze matches iron but lasts longer. Wearing a **full set** of either gives a bonus. Both take armor trims, and tin is itself a trim material.

**Forge Energy (FE):** the [[heat_turbine]] and [[steam_turbine]] burn furnace fuel into FE. They charge the [[charging_rail]], and with the [[energy_upgrade]] power locomotives and motorboats. They work with other mods' cables and machines too.

Tin and bronze also go into most of Xincraft's rails, carts and upgrades.
